title: More choices for text and images
summary:
More models and community-built tools arrived, while the APIs got clearer controls for filtering, privacy, and image inputs.

The text API added `gemini`, `gemini-thinking`, Hormoz 8B, and `deepseek-reasoner`. The `turbo` image model gained prompt enhancement with a 768-pixel maximum side length. Temperature and JSON-mode options are available for the new Gemini and Hormoz chat options; `qwen` was retired from the model list.

Image prompts gained LlamaGuard classification alongside existing checks, and feed filtering now accounts for additional maturity flags. The `end_generating` event gained nested maturity data and dropped `originalPrompt`. Text requests also gained `private=true` to keep responses off the public feed.

The project listings gained an underwater text adventure, an iOS chat app, a browser coding environment, a Telegram bot, a MIDI melody maker, and a multimodel chatbot. Pollinations.DIY also joined the monorepo. Apparently one API can lead to quite a few different tabs.

OpenAI-style responses gained consistent IDs, completion objects, and choice indexes. The docs added image and text SSE feed examples and clarified which models accept image inputs: `openai`, `openai-large`, and `claude-hybridspace`, but not Gemini models currently. Website sections also switched from background images to solid colors, with unused assets removed.
